# Masood Sultan - Portfolio

> Berlin-based geoscientist and AI engineer building evidence-based job matching, audited data-extraction workflows, and computational geoscience systems.

This portfolio presents selected projects, publications, research, and consulting work by Masood Sultan, spanning geoscience, geospatial data, AI systems, and web engineering.

## Key Pages

- [Portfolio home](https://masoodsultan.com/): projects, publications, academic CV, and contact
- [Blog](https://blog.masoodsultan.com/): research briefs and analysis on AI, geoscience, GIS, and computing
- [Maven Webcraft](https://mavenwebcraft.com/): web design and AI-search studio for small businesses

## About

- Name: Masood Sultan
